snippet.title: Fishing Shop Simulator
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3196270/Fishing_Shop_Simulator/

Hi everyone, this is a very special moment to announce something I've been quietly working on - I'm attempting to make my own game finally!  Been working on this while working full time, this is still very early in development!  

I'll use my youtube in the future to post updates on the game when I make enough progress to show new things getting added into the game!

The game currently has -
* Catching Fish (Different bodies of water have different fish and different chances)
* Fish size changes based on the weight
* Bait System - Costs money upfront, but gives you a chance at a good hit or finding certain fish depending on the bait
* Rare Variants (Holographic) that are worth a hecking lot but uncommon to find
* Building System
* Upgrading your shop
* Customers that will wander to your shop to buy fish on display
* Dog companion
* Town begins building around your shop as you rebuild it
* Inventory System

Things on my near current roadmap - 
* Add a 'Cozy System' which rewards you for decorating.  The higher the cozy bonus - the more customers will show up
* Classes of customers and their wealth - This will encourage you to decorate your shop more to attract richer customers, so you can sell more expensive fish
* Debt system
* Make better Dog system (And have dog animate...)
* New biomes (I have lots of cool areas planned!!)


I'm a huge fan of Tycoon/Shopkeeper/Simulator games, and I thought this would be a good genre for a first attempt and something that is a bit more doable for only one person.  Hope it can make some people interested and I'll post updates as I make progress!  

I will admit though, there will be times where I make no progress; I work full time and prioritizing not burning out and having a healthy life still.

Thanks to anybody who wishlists or just even enjoys the trailer!  You guys are my only advertisers - I'm just a solo dev so I'll have to rely on hoping people can spread word about the game as I get it looking and feeling better in the future! 

#fishing  #fishinggames #simulatorgames #simulator #shopkeepers #shopkeeper #psx
